text: But dheere dheere logon ne realize kiya ki TensorFlow bahut hi difficult to use tha. In fact, iske upar mazaak banne laga ki Google ne yeh library apne liye banayi hai, apne engineers ke liye banayi hai kyunki normal log toh yeh use bhi nahi kar paa rahe. In fact log yahan tak bolte the ki agar aapko TensorFlow use karna aata hai, toh Google mein aapka job lag jayega. Itna difficult tha yeh. Theek hai? Toh tabhi usi around mein Keras bolke ek library bani jo basically TensorFlow ke top pe kaam karti thi. Matlab user Keras se baat karta tha, Keras TensorFlow se baat karta tha. Toh intermediate library thi, basically front-end bol sakte ho aap. Aur jabse Keras aaya tabse phir kya hua ki bahut popular ho gaya in dono ka combination. That is why 2019 mein jab TensorFlow 2.0 aaya, toh Google ne realize kiya ki agar TensorFlow ko sach mein har kisi ke paas pahunchana hai, usko accessible banane ka tareeka hai Keras ke saath jud jao. Toh tabse Keras built-in aata hai TensorFlow ke saath.

topic_summary: The emergence of Keras for TensorFlow

text: Theek hai? Hum is course mein yahi combination use karenge. But ek doosra company Facebook bhi peeche nahi rehna chahta tha toh unhone 2016 mein PyTorch bol ke ek library start ki. Jo kamiyan jo bhi thi TensorFlow ki usko solve karne ka try kar rahi thi. Aur kuch acchi cheezein thi abhi technicality mein nahi ghuste. But AI researchers jo the unko yeh library bahut pasand aayi aur aaj ki date mein agar aap dekhoge, toh jo research wale log hote hain, industry wale nahi research wale log, wo PyTorch zyada use karte hain. Theek hai? Phir usi around mein 2018 mein unhone ek aur library ke upar kaam kiya, Caffe2 jiska kaam tha PyTorch models ko utha kar ke server pe deploy karna aur server pe run karna so that bahut saare log us model ko use kar payein. Aur phir thodi dino ke baad inhone in dono ko merge karke PyTorch ka complete framework banaya.
title: Machine Learning Explained

text: Theek hai? Toh aaj ki date mein aapke paas do frameworks hain. Ek hai TensorFlow plus Keras ka framework jo industry driven applications mein zyada use hota hai. Aur phir ek doosra aapka ecosystem hai PyTorch ka jo research purpose ke liye zyada use hota hai. Theek hai? Ab yahan par ek problem yeh aati hai ki kabhi-kabhi aisi zaroorat pad sakti hai ki aapko ek ka code kisi doosre mein convert karna ho. Theek hai? Toh ab aisa ho sakta hai matlab maan lo aap kisi researcher ka paper padh rahe ho jo internally PyTorch mein implemented hai aur aapko us code ko apni company mein implement karna hai jahan pe TensorFlow use ho raha hai. Toh is tarah ka inter-conversion thoda difficult tha. Toh yahan par phir ek aur cheez aayi.
title: Machine Learning Explained
topic_summary: Differences in using TensorFlow and PyTorch

text: Yahan par is tarah ke drop-down GUI based applications aane lag gaye jinka kaam kya tha ki aap us website pe jao aur GUI se aise connect kar-karke aap neural networks banao. Aur phir aap export ka option use karo aur aapko wo PyTorch ka bhi code de dega aur TensorFlow ka bhi code de dega. Theek hai? Jaise ki ek example main batata hoon, AutoML. Google ka product jo exactly yeh kaam karta hai. Theek hai? Iske alawa aur bhi is tareeke ka products hai jaise ki Microsoft ka Custom Vision AI hai, aapka Apple ka Create ML hai, yeh saare products aapke yahi kaam karte hain.

topic_summary: GUI based tools for model conversion

text: Toh in short hua kya, ki yeh jo powerful badi companies thi inhone is tarah ke frameworks banaye jinhone push diya deep learning ke research ko aur industry mein adoption ko. Theek hai? Toh yeh mere hisaab se third factor hai. So deep learning ke success ke peeche jo fourth sabse bada factor mujhe lagta hai wo hai deep learning architectures. Theek hai? Ab deep learning architecture kya hota hai? Pehle hi lecture mein samajhna thoda difficult hai. But main phir bhi try karta hoon. So maine thodi der pehle aapko ek neural network dikhaya tha ANN bol ke. Aur usmein kuch is tarah ka structure tha. Theek hai? Aisa tha isko main bol raha tha ANN. Artificial Neural Network. Theek hai? Toh ab yeh ANN hai. Ab is ANN mein do cheezein hain. Theek hai? So pehli cheez hai yeh node. Isko hum node bolte hain. Jo yeh saare circles hain, yeh saare nodes hain. Yeh basically ek fundamental unit hai aapke ANN ka.
title: Machine Learning Explained

text: Aur second hai yeh edges. Inko hum weights bolte hain. Yeh weights batate hain ki kaunse nodes kis node se connected hain. Theek hai? Ab in dono ko alag-alag tareeke se aap create kar sakte ho. Matlab a different neural network can have less nodes, aur it can have different types of edges, jaise yeh wala isse connected hai but yeh wala isse connected nahi hai. Theek hai? Toh in dono ke combinations ke saath experiment karke aap alag-alag type ka ANN bana sakte ho. Toh yeh jo hai, yeh ek architecture hai. This is one way of connecting nodes and edges ya weights. Theek hai? Similarly, this is the second architecture. Toh you can have different architectures. Aur alag-alag architectures mein kya different hota hai? Alag node ho sakta hai. Jaise CNN mein alag type ka node hota hai, yahan pe jaise perceptron hai, wahan pe doosra kuch node hota hai. RNN mein kuch aur node hota hai. Theek hai? Similarly, weights bhi alag-alag tareeke se connect ho sakte hain. Toh depending on the problem, you can create different neural network architectures. Theek hai?
title: Machine Learning Explained

text: Ab kaunsa best architecture hai yeh pata karne ke liye aapko experiment karna padega. Experiment mein time jayega, effort jayega, paisa jayega. Toh usse bachne ke liye aap researchers ka existing architecture use kar sakte ho jo pehle se trained hai on datasets aur ab wo ready to use hai. Matlab isko aap directly download karke apne problem pe apply kar do. Aur is concept ko bola jata hai transfer learning. Theek hai? Jo aaj ki date mein industry mein bahut use ho raha hai. Ab because of this concept ki aap doosron ka architecture use kar sakte ho, ek massive boost aaya hai deep learning ke adoption mein. Aaj ki date mein mujhe agar ek problem solve karna hai, toh mujhe baith karke apne researchers ko yeh nahi bolna hoga ki tum scratch se architectures banao. Rather, I can use a state-of-the-art architecture jo already best hai.
title: Machine Learning Explained

text: Matlab best accuracy hai in certain cases humans ka accuracy level ko cross kar chuka hai. Toh I can seedhe-seedhe use them. Theek hai? Toh aapne shayad inmein se kuch existing architectures ka naam bhi suna hoga. Jaise main aapko alag-alag domain ke architectures batata hoon. Jaise let's say aap image classification ka baat kar rahe ho jahan pe image ko ek class ya phir doosre class mein divide karna hai. Toh ResNet bol ke ek bahut famous neural network hai. Agar aap text classification ka baat kar rahe ho ya phir NLP related task ka baat kar rahe ho, toh BERT bol ke ek bahut famous architecture hai. It's a transformer shayad aapne naam suna hoga. Agar aap image segmentation ka baat kar rahe ho, toh phir apne paas hai UNet. Agar aap image translation ka baat kar rahe ho, toh phir hamare paas ek bahut famous hai Pix2Pix. Agar aap object detection ka baat kar rahe ho, toh hamare paas hai YOLO, You Only Look Once. Agar aap speech generation ka baat kar rahe ho, toh hamare paas hai WaveNet.
title: Machine Learning Explained

text: Toh yeh saare state-of-the-art architectures hain jo researchers ne apna time invest karke banaya, data pe train kiya aur ab yeh ready to use hain. Aapko bas inko download karna hai apne machine pe aur inko apne problem ke upar run karna hai. Theek hai? Toh inke aane ke baad jo aapka poora adoption tha deep learning ka wo bahut fast ho gaya kyunki cheezein thodi aasaan ho gayi. Kisi ne wo mehnat pehle se hi karke rakh di jo humein karni padti. Theek hai? Toh yeh mere hisaab se chautha reason hai. Agar aap mujhse pucho ki last reason kya hai, toh I would say ki factor number five is people. Ya phir aap community bol sakte ho. So yeh sab kuch possible nahi ho pata agar kuch bahut junoon rakhne wale log deep learning ki field mein nahi aaye hote. Deep learning ka jo history hai wo bahut hi interesting hai. 1960s se log kaam kar rahe hain, lekin multiple times fail hue aur 2011 ke around finally successful hue. Toh log jo hain, jo researchers hue, ya jo company mein aapke deep learning engineers hue, for that matter hamare jaise teachers hue, for that matter aapke jaise students hue, Kaggle jaisi community hui, in sabne mil karke deep learning ko as a technology aage badhaya hai. Theek hai?

text: Toh mere hisaab se number five pe nahi, shayad number one pe hona chahiye, but yeh thoda non-technical reason hai isliye main isko thoda alag rakh raha hoon.
